Q1_destination_still_learnt_before_actin.answer: Yes, acceptably — the fact is one tap away and it is not a fact the reader can act on differently.
Q1_destination_still_learnt_before_actin.where_it_lives: relay.health.ended_detail, the ended-state health sheet body: 'L’historique est conservé. Envoyez un message ou touchez « Reprendre » pour rouvrir la session dans votre dossier personnel.'
render_path_verified: src/features/session/components/session-health.tsx:283-286 — the header control is a Pressable whose onPress opens that sheet; its accessibilityHint is mobile.session_health.control_hint ('Affiche ce que signifie cet état et ce qu’un envoi fait maintenant.')
relay.health.ended_send_failed routes a failed reopen back to the same sheet
Q1_destination_still_learnt_before_actin.why_enough: The destination is not selectable: the session returns to the home folder and the app offers no alternative, so a reader who sends without opening the sheet gets the same outcome they would have chosen. The step that changes their decision is whether a send does anything at all — and that is what the placeholder now states at every scale. Consistency holds: the placeholder promises 'sending reopens' and the sheet promises the same reopen, in the home folder, for both sending and Resume.
Q1_destination_still_learnt_before_actin.cost_stated: Pre-send disclosure of the location is reduced from always (at 100 %) to one tap away. Before this change the same location was already lost at every scale above 100 %, together with the action half.

Q2_grammar_and_meaning.answer: Grammatical and idiomatic; meaning preserved except the destination; it under-promises rather than over-promises.
Q2_grammar_and_meaning.grammar: French takes an infinitive as subject with a finite verb (Fumer nuit…, Cliquer ici ouvre une fenêtre); this catalogue already ships the construction in the neighbouring sentence relay.health.quiet_detail ('Réessayer ne l’enverra pas en double.'). 'Envoyer' is the field's own button verb and its object is supplied by the field being typed in, so the ellipsis is motivated. Style guide: infinitive for actions (fr.md:14), vous address (:9); both hold.
Q2_grammar_and_meaning.meaning: 'Send to reopen in your home folder…' states sender + effect + location; 'Envoyer rouvre…' states sender + effect. No success guarantee is added (the failure case is relay.health.ended_send_failed), and no destination is claimed that is no longer named.
Q2_grammar_and_meaning.effect_on_design_D2: Design's D2 (MINOR: French named the outcome where English named the action) is closed as a side effect: 'Envoyer' restores the actor. Design round 4 predicted this outcome itself.

Q3_ship_over_parenthetical.reasoning: The 35-cell parenthetical buys the destination back only to ~135 % before it ellipsizes (threshold 1.345 on 390 pt, 1.07 on 320 pt), so it re-creates the defect design round 4 measured and re-introduces the ownerless parenthetical fr29sm2 rejected — while the 15-cell form fits every app step on both phone widths with 21-43 px to spare and leaves a non-selectable fact one tap away.

Q4_budget_superseded.answer: Yes, stated plainly: the cell budget was an inadequate proxy for fit and the measurement supersedes it for this key.
Q4_budget_superseded.detail: It is a character count inherited from core's maxCells; it cannot see a 348/278 px content box, a 16 px Figtree body, or a text-scale step. My own fr29sm3 'passed at exactly 36/36' used it as fit evidence and should not have. Design round 4 measured the field instead; this bundle re-derives the metric independently and records the instrument change.
